facts.text: Must be member of local administrator group on the computer to run Administration Shell.
PowerShell 7 is supported; Windows PowerShell 5 compatibility layer available in version 28 and earlier only.
Three PowerShell modules available: Microsoft.BusinessCentral.Management for server instances, Microsoft.BusinessCentral.Apps.Management for extensions, NAVWebClientManagement for web instances.
Install Administration Shell via Business Central Setup wizard by choosing Install Demo or Server option from setup.exe.
Run shell from Start menu by searching, right-clicking, and selecting Run as administrator.
For remote administration, enable PowerShell Remoting on remote computer, then use Enter-PSSession to connect locally.
PowerShell 7 based remoting not supported in version 28 due to known issue; must use Windows PowerShell 5.
Get-Help cmdlet syntax changed in version 24; local help unavailable, use Get-Help with -online flag for online documentation.
